ideas.pitch: An instant meal analyzer and campus mess dietary tracker built for an 8-hour sprint using multimodal AI.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence-powered platform connecting students with matching project partners, study materials, and lab equipment on campus.
ideas.title: CampusGraph: Real-Time Student Resource & Peer Collaboration Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph-based data structures for high-utility local matching, mimicking complex investigative graph platforms that win innovation awards.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered environmental monitoring dashboard that tracks local classroom power consumption and waste bin fill levels using simulated sensor feeds.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined multi-agent pipeline that takes a raw hackathon project idea and instantly generates an architecture diagram, tech stack, and slide outline.

ideas.pitch: A location-based safety scoring and peer-grouping app for students traveling back from campus late at night.
